findings.action: Add a backtick and repeated whitespace to the fixture's open finding summary and broken text, and record the digests under a new version only if the rendering changes
findings.rationale: The open finding's summary, file and broken-draft text in the fixtures carry no backtick and no run of whitespace, so quoteLedgerText (review_rounds.go:577), which rewrites both, is never exercised: changing how it quotes earlier findings changes the round-2+ briefs of real runs (whose summaries often contain backticks) without moving the digest.

findings.action: Put the fixture criteria, entries, facts and evidence (at least two) out of order
findings.rationale: The fixture criteria, subject entries, structural facts and evidence are already in sorted order (one evidence entry), so the sorts in renderReviewBriefBody (review_brief.go:278, 310, 349, 363) are not under the digest: dropping or changing a comparator would reorder real briefs without moving the digest.
